thread:
jess: Quick postmortem: our hotset estimator is showing a clear bias for prefetched keys. Looks like sampling fires immediately after prefetch completion so we overcount short-lived prefetches.

rana: That matches the surprising hotset jump on tenant-prod last Friday. Any quick fixes?

jess: Two lightweight options: add random jitter after prefetch (cheap) or sample at request midpoint (cleaner but needs request lifecycle hooks).

ty: Jitter seems low-risk. How much jitter did you try?

jess: 50-200ms. 100ms mostly removes the bias in bench, but microbatch extreme cases still show ~1.2x. Midpoint is unbiased.

rana: Can we A/B behind flag? Also keep a separate prefetch-event stream for ops so they don't lose visibility.

jess: Yep, PR incoming with flag telemetry.kvcache_sampling={end,jitter,midpoint} and jitter_ms. Adding canary panels: R ratio and CPU per-sample.

metrics-bot: CI for PR #4839 queued.

ty: I'll flip jitter on canary tonight and watch R and P95.

jess: Thanks — I'll add a tiny unit test and a flamegraph capture.
